review.notes: The selected source closure is pinned for local development, including libplacebo's Jinja and MarkupSafe build-only submodules. FFmpeg and OpenSSL signatures were validated against fingerprints published on their official sites. VideoLAN's checksum matches, but its libbluray signature uses an expired DSA/SHA-1 release key and is not sufficient release evidence. Remaining signatures, license obligations, reproducible universal artifacts, and the complete closure still require independent review before distribution. On 2026-10-27 the closure gained MoltenVK, SPIRV-Cross, cereal, shaderc, glslang, SPIRV-Tools and SPIRV-Headers (and MoltenVK's own pins of SPIRV-Tools, SPIRV-Headers and Vulkan-Headers) for gpu-next on Metal, and mpv carries NativeDependencies/patches/mpv/0001-player-add-moltenvk-context.patch from MPVKit; all are pending the same review.
